basic_profile.bio: Hello, I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Austin, Texas. I've recently gotten into Reddit to explore different communities and connect with people who share my interests. I'm a huge fan of video games, especially retro ones, and I enjoy learning about the history of gaming. Besides gaming, I'm also interested in card games like Magic: The Gathering and love discussing strategies and decks. Although I'm still figuring out my career path, I'm leaning towards something in technology or game design. I usually browse Reddit during my free time after school and on weekends. I'm single and often chat with friends online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is primarily shaped by my hobbies and interests. I've been a self-taught gamer since I was 10, and I've picked up a lot from YouTube tutorials and online guides. I'm also a member of my school's gaming club, where I learn from peers and share tips.
